Implemented `refund(payment, amount, at)` in `ledgerly/adjustments.py`:

- Validates and rounds the amount via `round_money`, rejecting non-positive amounts with `non_positive_amount`.
- Only allows captured (or already partially refunded) payments, raising `invalid_state` otherwise.
- Validates `at` through `ensure_utc`.
- Accumulates `payment.refunded_amount`, rejecting over-refunds with `refund_exceeds_captured`.
- Sets `payment.status = "refunded"` when fully refunded, records an audit event, and returns the payment.

All 10 tests pass, including manual edge-case checks.
